exposure: birth weight between 1500 g and 2500 g
duration of membrane rupture greater than 24 hours
outcome: prolonged length of hospital stay after cesarean section
cohort: The study included 423 women who had given birth via cesarean section in public hospitals in Gurage Zone, Southern Ethiopia.
finding: 21.7% of mothers experienced prolonged hospital stays after cesarean section, with gestational age less than 37 weeks, birth weight less than 2500g, and duration of membrane rupture greater than 24 hours being identified as associated factors.
birth_weight: Birth weights less than 1500 g and between 1500 g and 2500 g were identified among the included babies as factors associated with prolonged hospital stay.
gest_age: Gestational age less than 37 weeks was identified among the included babies as a factor associated with prolonged hospital stay.
